name: guangdada-crawl
description: Lightweight Guangdada crawling for Codex: charts, advertisers, single ads, job artifacts, and an optional MCP wrapper.

interface.shortDescription: 轻量广大大爬取入口，只产 raw/job artifact。
interface.longDescription: A lightweight Codex plugin for raw Guangdada crawling. It exposes a safe CLI and optional MCP tools for chart crawls, advertiser/app crawls, single ad detail seeds, auth diagnostics, job listing, and artifact inspection. It deliberately does not write VE, Arrow2, Feishu Bitable, LLM analysis, dashboards, or push notifications by default.
defaultPrompt: Run a Guangdada chart crawl dry run.
Crawl Guangdada creatives for this advertiser.
Inspect the latest Guangdada crawl job artifacts.
